title: Sensor: sensor review and single-participant sample
description: Review of eleven devices and two software platforms with six CSV resources from one participant. Raw sensor and questionnaire observations cover Session 1; supplied eye summaries cover three sessions. The author reports consent for research and educational sharing. Analysis is descriptive; acquisition, calibration and cross-stream synchronization provenance are missing. CC BY 4.0 covers original observations and authored documentation where rights are held. Code is MIT. Third-party questionnaire wording, answer options, product images and trademarks remain outside that grant; open instrument redistribution permission is unestablished. See NOTICE.md and DATA_ETHICS.md. Metadata alone establishes no deposited record or DOI.
